    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Main
    Application entry point.
    MainFrame
    Main window of the Task Management System (Swing GUI, Notion-style dark theme).
    MainFrame.StatusRenderer
    Draws the status as a colored pill, like Notion tags.
    Status
    Possible states of a task.
    Task
    A single to-do item with a title, description and status.
    TaskManager
    Manages tasks: add, view, update, delete and set status.
